title: Augmentation commutes with restricted total inclusion
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], K a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], T an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation of K [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation], and q any integer. Let Rq and aq be the explicit restricted total and augmentation [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-total-construction] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-augmentation]. Define jq : Rq \to Tot(T.I) by applying the identity mapped-bicomplex functor, flipping, and totalizing the column inclusion \sigma_{\ge q} T.I \to T.I. Then aq \mathbin{;} jq = (\sigma_{\ge q} K \to K) \mathbin{;} T.aug.

source.place: Lemma 13.21.3, proof remark (3), finite-diagonal total comparison; Tag 0133, explicit augmented total map

proof.text:
Evaluate in total degree n and use the formula for a totalized map on
its degree-zero resolution summand. Naturality of extension by zero transports
that summand to the degree-zero summand of the full total. If n ≥ q, the
stupid-truncation projection followed by its inclusion is the identity on
T.I.X n. Cancel this pair in etaleRestrictedAugmentationComponent and apply
T.aug_formula. If n < q, the source term of the truncated K is zero, so the
two maps are equal. Chain-map extensionality now proves the equation. The
calculation has no positivity condition on q, and also covers the zero complex
and empty diagonals.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleRestrictedAugmentation_inclusion
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (T : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K) (q : ℤ) :
    etaleRestrictedAugmentation X K T q ≫ etaleRestrictedTotalInclusion X K T q =
      K.obj.ιStupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE q) ≫ T.aug
